messages:
marta.ae: Quick notes from SentinelBank POC kickoff — they want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and role-based access for reviewers/admins. Also asked about domain-locked tenant and audit log retention.

ben.eng: Got it. Which IdPs are they standardizing on? Any special cert/signature requirements?

marta.ae: They listed Okta and PingFederate. They require SHA-256 signatures, SP-initiated SSO, and optional signed logout.

reena.sec: Please have them complete the security questionnaire. Key items: encryption at rest (KMS), tenant isolation, access reviews, SOC2 report, pen-test cadence, and MFA for admin users. We need IdP metadata and a sample SAML Response (PII redacted) to verify assertion handling.

ben.eng: For SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 with support for PATCH, incremental sync, and bulk import. Typical attribute set we ask for: userName, id (externalId), active, name, emails, groups. If they want role assignment via SCIM, include an extension attribute e.g. "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User": {"roles": ["approver"]}. Example test payload we send them: 

`curl -X POST https://poc.redwood.example/scim/v2/Users -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"userName":"sarah@sentinel.com","active":true,"name":{"givenName":"Sarah","familyName":"Ng"}}'`

alex.sre: Note on provisioning throughput: default bulk window is 300 users/min on Dedicated; we can raise to 1k/min temporarily for the POC with an ops change. Also we emit provisioning events to the audit stream at INFO level.

marta.ae: Commercial ask: customer wants price comparison for a 10-day dedicated POC vs hosted usage. They also asked if onboarding fee can be reduced.

ben.eng: Technical risks: Ping sometimes uses encrypted assertions (AES) — our SP supports encrypted assertions but we need the encryption cert. Also they require a fixed signing cert rotation policy. Ask them to confirm certificate rollover schedule.

reena.sec: For Private deployments they want HSM-backed key wraps. We offer KMS + HSM add-on. Also we need to confirm network egress controls and whether logs must stay on-prem.

marta.ae: I'll push commercial flexibility. Proposed draft: 10-day Dedicated POC (2x A10G equiv), 8 hours SE on-call, waived onboarding if they sign LOI for pilot > $40k within 45 days. Estimate $8,400 + travel if needed. Thoughts?

ben.eng: Sounds reasonable. Add a line item for extra SCIM sync limit if they need >5k users.

alex.sre: POC environment spun up: https://console.redwood.example/poc/sentinel-1768739999 — credentials shared with AE via secure link. deploy-bot: env created and telemetry enabled.

marta.ae: Next actions: 1) I will send the security questionnaire and pricing draft to the customer, 2) Ben will share SP metadata and SCIM endpoint details, 3) Reena will attach SOC2/pen-test docs and HSM options.

ben.eng: I'll upload SP metadata (SAML) and a short runbook for test flows. Sample SP metadata generator command I use: `./bin/generate-sp --entity-id https://poc.redwood.example/saml --acs https://poc.redwood.example/saml/acs > sp-metadata.xml`

reena.sec: I'll request their IdP metadata + a redacted SAML response. Also flagging audit log retention: default 90 days for Dedicated; we can extend with an add-on.

marta.ae: Customer asked about domain-locked signups: we can restrict registrations to verified domains and enforce org-level allowlist. For fully locked tenant we recommend Dedicated or Private.

alex.sre: Also call out that role mapping can be done via SAML attributes or SCIM groups. If they need mapping by Okta group GUIDs, enable group sync and include the GUIDs in the mapping table.

marta.ae: Great. I'll loop the customer in and request metadata + expected user count (they mentioned ~450 users for initial sync). Will update here when they respond. :white_check_mark:
